lines.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy greet the Thessalonians with grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Paul thanks God because their faith is growing, and he boasts about their perseverance among God's churches despite persecution.
God will grant relief to the Thessalonians and Paul's team when Jesus is revealed from Jerusalem with His mighty angels.
Jesus will inflict vengeance in blazing fire on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel.
Paul prays God will count them worthy of His honor, so Jesus's name is glorified in them.
